title: Hydrogen-bonded water bulk-response ledger
statement: A water bulk-response claim must retain the molecular hydrogen-bond network, specimen and phase identity, boiling, solid/liquid density and heat-capacity observations with their conditions, methods and uncertainty boundaries.
generation_rule: Generate the literal Cartesian product of the eight registered binary preservation decisions.
